notes.title: Full version coming soon!
notes.notes: Work is underway for the next update! Since the release of v0.3.3, I've been able to add many teaks, and much more. New bosses, new stages, new music tracks! The coolest part? This next release will be, finally, the full version of Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed v1.0! Coming soon!

notes.title: Version 0.2.4 Live Now!
notes.notes:
Be among the first people to play Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed! Get a taste of the game early and experience first-hand the development process of this remake :) 

At this point, the original 1990 ZX Spectrum /Amstrad CPC game has been remade in its entirety (with extras!), and you can give it a try before any additional content is included (expanded levels and boss battles being the main thing)
